findings.description: One item per real problem. Empty if the emails follow the rules.

file.description: Path of the email file, from the repo root.

line.description: Line number where the problem is.

severity.description: high = breaks a rule or makes a banned claim. medium = clearly off-voice. low = small polish.

problem.description: What is wrong, in one or two plain sentences.

fix.description: A specific change that fixes it.
